title: Tiny, cute robot vacuum
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffaa" stop-opacity="0.8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffffaa" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- soft glow under robot -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="34" ry="8" fill="none" stroke="#88ddff" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.45"/>
  <!-- main body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="30" ry="22" fill="#5ec8f0"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="30" ry="22" fill="none" stroke="#9be8ff" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- top dome -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="18" ry="14" fill="#a8e6ff"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="18" ry="14" fill="none" stroke="#d7f6ff" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- cute face on dome -->
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="47" rx="3.5" ry="4.5" fill="#1d3a66"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="47" rx="3.5" ry="4.5" fill="#1d3a66"/>
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="46" rx="1.5" ry="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="46" rx="1.5" ry="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="52" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#ff9ec4" opacity="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="52" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#ff9ec4" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M45 53 Q50 58 55 53" fill="none" stroke="#1d3a66" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- bumper band -->
  <path d="M22 65 Q50 74 78 65" fill="none" stroke="#3a9fcf" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- side brushes -->
  <g fill="#ffcc44" stroke="#ffea99" stroke-width="1">
    <circle cx="18" cy="72" r="5"/>
    <line x1="18" y1="72" x2="12" y2="68" stroke="#ffcc44" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="18" y1="72" x2="13" y2="76" stroke="#ffcc44" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="18" y1="72" x2="20" y2="77" stroke="#ffcc44" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="82" cy="72" r="5"/>
    <line x1="82" y1="72" x2="88" y2="68" stroke="#ffcc44" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="82" y1="72" x2="87" y2="76" stroke="#ffcc44" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="82" y1="72" x2="80" y2="77" stroke="#ffcc44" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>
  <!-- front sensor bump -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#3a9fcf"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="6" ry="3" fill="none" stroke="#88ddff" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- little wheels peeking out -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="80" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#2e5a8a"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="80" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#2e5a8a"/>
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="80" rx="2" ry="1.2" fill="#7ab8e0"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="80" rx="2" ry="1.2" fill="#7ab8e0"/>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <line x1="50" y1="34" x2="50" y2="24" stroke="#9be8ff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="21" r="3.5" fill="#ff88cc"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="21" r="3.5" fill="none" stroke="#ffccee" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="20" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
</svg>
